One of the coolest parts of DevX at Google DeepMind is the breadth of scope. They do so much more than a traditional DevRel team:

- Partner directly with research, building benchmarks, providing feedback on capabilities (e.g. agentic behaviors, Gemma design, etc.) and teamfooding models early
- Lead the collaborations across agentic harnesses (OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, ...) and 3P SDKs for day 0 readiness, meeting devs wherever they build and ensuring our models work well there
- Drive GTM across our model and tool launches, day 0 integrations, dev guides, demos, and developer-grounded messaging
- Design APIs, ship skills/docs, and build automations
- All on top of hundreds of events, high-quality content, and educational initiatives

You can just do things. Truly a cracked team of engineers with high product taste, relentless developer empathy, and strong technical skills. Excited to see what they cook next
